players.bio: Andrew John Smith (born 11 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Gillingham.
Armani George Little (born 5 April 1997) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Gillingham.

Bradley Paul Dack (born 31 December 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Gillingham. Dack was born in the London Borough of Greenwich, and attended Beths Grammar School in Bexley. His first academy side was Charlton Athletic, where he spent three years before being released at the age of 14.
Cameron Akwasi Antwi (born 7 October 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Gillingham F.C. in EFL League Two.
Conor McManus is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left wing-back for EFL League Two club Gillingham F.C..
Eli Josef King is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Gillingham.
Ethan Jay Coleman (born 28 January 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Gillingham.

Garath James McCleary is a professional footballer who plays as a right winger or attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club Gillingham. McCleary's football career began with Oxford City, and spent time with Oxford United but never signed a contract with the team despite spending 3 months with the club. He joined Slough Town playing in 24 games and scoring on six occasions.

Gareth Ainsworth (born 10 May 1973) is an English professional former player and football manager who is the manager of EFL League Two club Gillingham. He retired from regular playing appearances to concentrate on his management duties in April 2013, but remains registered as a player. He managed to lead the club to promotion out of EFL League Two at the end of the 2017–18 season.
Harry Lee Waldock (born 20 December 2006) is an English footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Gillingham.

Jack Daley is a English professional footballer who currently plays as a centre-back for League Two club Gillingham F.C.. He joined the club on a season-long loan from Championship side Middlesbrough F.C. on 30 August 2026,
James Robert Brophy (born 25 July 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for League Two club Gillingham FC .

Kadeem Raymond Mathurin-Harris (born 8 June 1993), known as Kadeem Harris, is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Gillingham FC . A versatile player, Harris has been deployed as a central midfielder, attacking midfielder, winger or forward.

Lamin Sillah is a 20-year-old Gambian professional footballer who plays as a forward or centre-forward. He is currently playing for Gillingham F.C. in EFL League Two, on a season-long loan from Premier League club Nottingham Forest.
Liam Craig Gordon (born 26 January 1996) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two side Gillingham F.C.

Logan Dobbs is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL League Two club Gillingham F.C.. Standing at 6 ft 4 in, the academy graduate has emerged as a breakout player for the Gills during the 2026–27 season.

Michael Luxton is an 18-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Gillingham F.C.. Wearing the number 27 shirt, he came through the club's youth academy and made his senior first-team debut as a substitute in March 2026.
Nick Freeman (born 7 November 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League Two club Gillingham.
Ollie Wright is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Gillingham, on loan from EFL Championship club Southampton.

Omar Jerome Beckles (born 25 October 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Gillingham. Born in England, he represents the Grenada national team. He is the chair of the Professional Footballers' Association.
Robbie McKenzie (born 25 September 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays for Gillingham as a defender.
Rohan Luthra is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Gillingham F.C..

Ronan Aiden Connolly Shea Chapman Hale (born 8 September 1998) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League Two club Gillingham and the Northern Ireland national team. He previously played for Birmingham City, Derry City, Crusaders, St Patrick's Athletic, Larne, Cliftonville and Ross County.
Sheldon Kendall is an 18-year-old professional footballer who plays as a right winger or forward for Gillingham F.C., on a season-long loan from Millwall F.C..

Taite Holtam is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League Two club Gillingham F.C.. Born on 14 February 2005, the academy graduate signed his first professional contract with the Gills in May 2024.

Thomas James Eaves is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Gillingham. He joined Oldham Athletic's Centre of Excellence as a youth player at Under-15 age group having previously been at Crewe Alexandra. He made his Football League debut on 23 January 2010
William Neil Goodwin (born 7 May 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Gillingham FC

Zane Albarus is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for English League Two club Gillingham F.C.. Known for his work rate, tenacity, and positional versatility, Albarus can operate as a central midfielder, defensive midfielder, or right-back.
